meta.title: FAQ: Everything about locking in
meta.description: How Welockin blocks apps and sites, the five unlock difficulty levels, Nuclear Mode, supported devices, privacy and troubleshooting: answered.

hub.title: Frequently asked questions
hub.mascotAlt: Peep, the Welockin mascot, looking apologetic

getting-started.name: Getting started
getting-started.headline: Getting started with Welockin
getting-started.intro: What Welockin is, who it is built for, and how to go from downloading it to your first locked session in under a minute.
getting-started.description: What Welockin is, who it's for, how it works, and how to set it up on your first device. Answered by the students who built it.

what-you-can-block.name: What you can block
what-you-can-block.headline: What you can block with Welockin
what-you-can-block.intro: Apps, websites, whole categories and notifications: what Welockin can shut out, and how to group it all so one tap covers a whole context.
what-you-can-block.description: Block any app or website, one-tap categories for adult content, gambling, dating and games, plus notifications, bundles and schedules.

unlock-difficulty-levels.name: Unlock difficulty levels
unlock-difficulty-levels.headline: The five unlock difficulty levels
unlock-difficulty-levels.intro: Welockin lets you choose how hard it is to quit a session, from a PIN you can type in two seconds to a lock nothing lifts before the date you set. Here is what each level does and which one to pick.
unlock-difficulty-levels.description: PIN, cooldown delay, accountability partner, passphrase, and lock-until-a-date. What each unlock difficulty level does and which to choose.

nuclear-mode.name: Nuclear Mode
nuclear-mode.headline: Nuclear Mode: the point of no return
nuclear-mode.intro: Nuclear Mode locks a category until a date you choose, with no override and no back door. It is the most-asked-about part of Welockin, and the part we refuse to soften. Here is exactly what it does.
nuclear-mode.description: Nuclear Mode locks until a date you set, with no override, no early unlock, and no bypass by restarting or deleting the app.

devices-and-platforms.name: Devices & platforms
devices-and-platforms.headline: Devices and platforms Welockin supports
devices-and-platforms.intro: Which operating systems Welockin runs on today, what is coming, and how one session locks every device you link at the same time.
devices-and-platforms.description: Welockin runs on macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Windows, with Android coming. Link as many devices as you want. They lock together as one.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.headline: Privacy: what Welockin does and does not see
privacy.intro: A blocker sits between you and the internet, which makes what it logs a fair question. The short answer: filtering happens on your device, and your browsing is not recorded.
privacy.description: Welockin does not log the sites you visit. Filtering happens on your device, so blocking works without sending your browsing to a server.

troubleshooting.name: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.headline: Troubleshooting Welockin
troubleshooting.intro: Something not blocking, devices out of sync, or a block you need lifted: the common problems and what to do about each.
troubleshooting.description: Fixes for the common problems: something not being blocked, devices not syncing, unblocking what you need, and how to reach a human.
